page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.6xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor based on the x86_64 architecture. The instance offers 12 physical cores and 24 dedicated vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. It is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The processor includes 35 MB of L3 cache along with support for AVX-512 vector instructions and AES encryption. This instance features an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, contains no local ephemeral storage, and includes no dedicated GPU accelerators.

In synthetic benchmarks, the instance demonstrates moderate parallel processing capability alongside lower single-threaded performance. Single-core tests placed the instance in the lower performance quartile, as indicated by a Geekbench single-core score of 1008.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 1107.98. Multi-core performance scales effectively across the 24 vCPUs, yielding average benchmark results such as a PassMark CPU score of 18227.84 and a multi-threaded stress-ng score of 17544.06. Memory performance showed mixed results, with large-block uncached memory read bandwidth reaching 90.15 GB/sec, though overall PassMark memory scores ranked in the lower quartile.

From a resource density and cost efficiency perspective, the instance provides balanced allocation for general compute workloads that rely on multi-threaded execution rather than high single-core clock speed. The baseline 8 Gbps network interface and 16.81 million operations per second in Redis SET tests support containerized applications, microservices, software compilation, and web serving, evidenced by a static web serving throughput of 13.07 GB/sec. Additionally, the instance handles lightweight AI tasks, achieving 75.32 tokens per second for small-model LLM generation. It is suited for general-purpose application servers, middle-tier enterprise software, and moderate database workloads where local storage is offloaded to remote block storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance based on the x86_64 architecture, powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor. It provides 12 physical CPU cores, 24 dedicated vCPUs, and 96.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The server features an 8 Gbps network bandwidth baseline, contains no local storage, and lacks discrete GPU acceleration. In benchmark evaluations, the instance shows weaker single-threaded performance, as seen in lower single-core Geekbench scores, but delivers solid mid-range multi-core capability with a PassMark CPU score of 18227.84 and stress-ng multi-core score of 17544.06. Memory write speeds reach 50.79 GB/sec on uncached large blocks. The instance offers practical qualitative efficiency for multi-threaded enterprise tasks, static web serving at 13.07 GB/sec, Redis caching, CI/CD compilation, and middle-tier application deployments relying on attached network storage.
